lines.text: Oh great, a graph problem. This one wrecks half the kids on the SAT.
Three sixty bucks. x student tickets, y adult tickets. Which equation fits the graph?
Look at the ends, genius. No students? Eighteen adults. Three sixty over eighteen: twenty bucks a ticket.
No adults? Twenty-four students. Three sixty over twenty-four: fifteen bucks. Not rocket science. I'd know.
You've got both prices. Write the equation. I'll wait.
Fifteen x for the students, plus twenty y for the adults, equals the budget. Boom: fifteen x plus twenty y equals three sixty.
Seven hundred more in SAT Math Learner. Go get smarter.
